description.narrative: Cooperation between Sida and NEFCO for demonstration of energy efficiency and environmental improvements in Ukrainian distric heating utilities. About 10 municipalities will implement projects supported by Sida, max 3 MSEK per roject, linked to a loan from NEFCO, max 400 000 Euro.Sida support,30 MSEK, will enable investments of 8-10 MEuro, annual emissions reductions of 40 000-50 000 ton CO2.

Samarbete mellan Sida och NEFCO för demonstrationsprojekt för miljöförbättringar och energieffektivisering i ukrainska fjärrvärmebolag. Ca 10 kommuner kommer genomföra projekt med stöd från Sida, max 3 MSEK per projekt länkat till lån från NEFCO, max 400 000 Euro.Sidas stöd,30 MSEK, möjliggör investeringar om 8-10 MEuro, årliga utsläppsminskningar 40 000-50 000 ton CO2.

The DemoUkrainaDH programme was established in 2011 in cooperation between NEFCO, Sida and the Ministry for Regional Development, Housing, Construction and Municipal Services of Ukraine (Minregion) with the objective to implement demonstration projects for modern and energy efficient district heating in Ukraine. Initially the target was to implement 10 demonstration projects in different Ukrainian cities. In 2013 the programme was extended to include intotal 20 demonstration projects.

The DemoUkrainaDH programme was finalised during 2022, in accordance with what was agreed with Sida.
The program has 12 completed projects and 10 cancelled/ rejected projects. To date, this allowed to achieve the annual reduction of 19,451 tCO2 emissions and 8,9 million m3 of gas consumption. Out of totally committed grant funds equal to 6,66 MEUR , the total amount of allocated grant funds is 3.28 MEUR (49%), whereas 3.38 MEUR (51%) is unallocated. By the end of 2022 the following results have been achieved:
1) Zhytomyr - renovated a district heating area by installation of new efficient boilers, introduction IHS and replacement of district heating pipelines.
2) Vinnytsia - decommissioned one inefficient boiler house, connected the heat load to an area with more efficient boilers and IHS in 11 residential buildings were introduced.
3) Oleksandria - installed new condensing boilers in a central heating substation (CHS), renovated district heating pipelines and installated a small scale CHP for production of the electric energy needed for the demand of the boiler house.
4) Kamyanets-Podilsky - installed 22 individual heating together with installation of new network distribution pump equipment, enabling variable flow in the heating system. Additional 8 IHS were contracted in the frame of available loan and grant.
5) Ivano-Frankivsk - decommissioned one boiler house and connected the heat load to another boiler house and IHS were introduced in the whole interconnected heating area. In total 38 individual heating substations. Additional 21 IHS were contracted in the frame of available loan and grant. These IHS were installed in another heating area.
6) Poltava - renovated a district heating area by installation of new efficient boilers, introduction of IHS and replacement of district heating pipelines.
7) Myrgorod - renovated a separate heating district located in the outskirts of the city, including replacement of outdated gas fired boilers, replacement of DH pipelines, and installation of IHS at houses.
8) Ternopil - Converted an existing gas-fired boiler to biofuel pellets and installed IHS to a fully demand driven 2-pipe DH system.
9) Chernivtsi - installed biofuel boiler and interconnected two heating areas. As a result, one boiler house with low efficiency gas boilers can be closed down. DH pipelines were replaced and IHS were installed in one of the interconnected areas to a fully demand driven 2-pipe DH system.
10) Berdychiv - electricity saving measures were implemented in different boiler houses, including replacement of pumps and fans. During implementation the supply and installation contract was supplemented with frequency converters for the motors with highest capacity.
11) Uman - biomass district heating generation at a remote district of the main DH system. Connection of all buildings to the upgraded network and replacement of up to 700 meters of DH main networks.
12) Mykolaiv - close-down of small gas-fired boiler houses, interconnection and change of DH pipeline routing.
